firmographics.narrative_md: Empower Federal Credit Union is a credit union. It reports $4.1 billion in total assets. It is regulated by NCUA (NCUSO ID 3025) and employs approximately 501 people across 24 branches. Its overall digital maturity is assessed at 2.1 out of 5 across the DMA capability framework.
